evals.name: fix-boundary-lint
evals.prompt: Configure golangci-lint with depguard to ensure internal/core cannot import internal/adapter packages.
evals.expected_output: A .golangci.yml configuration with depguard rules enforcing architectural boundaries.
assertions: Specifies rule preventing core/domain packages from importing adapter packages.

evals.name: resolve-lint-without-nolint
evals.prompt: A linter warns about unhandled error from defer resp.Body.Close(). Fix it properly without using //nolint.
evals.expected_output: Idiomatic error handling in defer (e.g. named return error wrapping or explicit error check).
assertions: Resolves error without adding //nolint suppression directive.
Checks error and combines with return error if applicable.

evals.name: pre-commit-lint-pipeline
evals.prompt: Set up a git pre-commit hook that runs golangci-lint only on modified Go files before commit.
evals.expected_output: A pre-commit configuration or shell hook executing golangci-lint run against staged files.
assertions: Targets staged .go files to keep commit times fast.
Aborts commit if lint errors are detected.
